scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.emulators:exchange: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage
scripts.dev:exchange: NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=true NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-hi-coworking.firebaseapp.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-hi-coworking NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=demo-hi-coworking.appspot.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=1234567890 NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID=1:1234567890:web:demo npm run dev --workspace web -- --port 3002
scripts.dev:exchange:demo: NEXT_PUBLIC_EXCHANGE_DEMO_MODE=true NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-hi-coworking.firebaseapp.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-hi-coworking NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=demo-hi-coworking.appspot.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=1234567890 NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID=1:1234567890:web:demo npm run dev --workspace web -- --port 3002
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only firestore,storage "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run tests/functions"
scripts.test:migrations: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only firestore "vitest run tests/migrations"
scripts.test:security: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1 tests/rules tests/functions tests/migrations"
scripts.test:run3: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run tests/run3 tests/functions/run3-*.test.ts"
scripts.test:run4: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run tests/run4"
scripts.test:week1-org: npm run build:functions && node --test apps/functions/test/exchange-organization-model.test.cjs apps/functions/test/organization-import.test.cjs apps/functions/test/development-account-bootstrap.test.cjs && vitest run tests/exchange/week1-organization-reconciliation.test.ts
